facts.text: I am trying to increase engagement on my social media profiles.
I have been posting more frequently on Facebook.
I posted a picture of my new haircut on Instagram three days ago.
My Instagram post about my new haircut got 47 likes and 2 comments.
I have been experimenting with Instagram Stories.
My most popular Instagram Story was a behind-the-scenes look at my morning routine.
My behind-the-scenes morning routine Instagram Story got 120 views.
I had a good experience with Instagram Stories.
I want to increase my engagement on Twitter.
I recently tweeted about the new restaurant that opened in my neighborhood.
My Twitter post about the new restaurant got 5 likes and 1 retweet.
I think I will try to use more hashtags on Twitter.
I have been experimenting with hashtags on Instagram.
I have seen an increase in engagement from using hashtags on Instagram.
I am considering whether to post more frequently on Twitter or focus on quality over quantity.
I have been trying to increase my engagement on Facebook.
I have been posting more frequently on Facebook.
I am not sure whether I should focus on posting more personal or professional content on Facebook.
I recently posted a picture of my cat on Facebook.
My Facebook cat picture got 52 likes and 4 comments.
My Facebook cat picture is my most popular post in the past two weeks.
